title: MORGELON
logline: Itch, strings, sores — then the pulls feel too good. Worms in the blood, webs in your sleep, trees under the eyelids. Colorado watches. Every extraction makes more thread.
disclaimer: Fiction · satisfying-disgust body horror · not medical advice · prosthetics only

style_bible.look: Morgellons-coded itch/strings/ulcers escalating to hallucinated vein-worms, sleep-aspens, spider-web shoots; Dr Pimple Popper dead-center extraction macros (satisfying disgust) + Colorado gold beauty as bait; The Fly wet practical
style_bible.camera: bright clean macro on the pull, hold the hole, drone canopy, locked consensus turns, doorway airlock
style_bible.negative: cabin witch, sprint zombies, cartoon mushrooms, haunted VHS, jokey pimple-pop host VO, comedy pus fountain, hypoxia-was-a-dream twist, purple alien goo, filming real self-harm

shots.image_prompt: Cinematic 16:9 Colorado autumn aspen sea from slightly elevated drone angle, white trunks and gold canopy breathing as one organism, cold blue mountain shadow, photoreal, sacred beauty, subtle dread, no text no logos no people.
shots.video_prompt: Slow legal-drone style push over a Colorado aspen canopy in gold. The whole stand sways once together. Horror of beauty. No text.

shots.narration: Below the grade, they still tell you to leave.
shots.on_screen: There is nothing in your skin.
shots.support: Visitor center. Clinic. Denial before the switchbacks.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 mountain-town clinic or visitor center doorway, harsh fluorescents against cold window light, empty chair, staff jacket walking away, Resident Evil geometry, photoreal, no brands.
shots.video_prompt: Enter doorway, Colorado valley clinic, figure exits down hall, focus to door. Locked dread.

shots.narration: Always itching. Strings in the sore. The pull feels too good — then another thread climbs.
shots.support: Popper macro grammar. Horror owns the aftertaste.
shots.image_prompt: Extreme macro 16:9 clinical bright light on a prosthetic ulcer with a pale wet filament mid-extraction by metal tweezers, Dr Pimple Popper framing dead-center, satisfying disgust, photoreal, glycerin sheen, second thread visible at frame edge, no real injury, no text, no logos, no smiling host.
shots.video_prompt: Dead-center macro: tweezers slowly draw a wet filament from a prosthetic sore under clean bright light. Hold the hole. A second thread creeps in at the edge. Silent ASMR horror. No comedy VO.

shots.narration: Thin air does not confuse them. It makes them agree.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 three calm hikers at a Colorado mountain overlook, wind-cut jackets, turning toward camera in the same posture, slight smiles, alpine light, photoreal horror of agreement, no sprinting, no gore.
shots.video_prompt: Locked-off overlook. Three hikers turn to camera on one pulse, same smile. Wind. Horror of consensus.

shots.narration: Radios overlap. Tracks converge. The grade edits the party.
shots.support: Action-cam breath. Calm faces in cutaways.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 Colorado mountain switchback road or trail climbing into aspens and rock, cold dusk, lonely guardrail, photoreal, subtle unease, no text.
shots.video_prompt: Ascent POV on switchbacks, heavy breath, cut implication of calm group ahead. Documentary snap.

shots.narration: They came for the gold. Their looking finishes the harvest.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 scenic Colorado overlook parking lot at golden hour, visitors with phones and tripods, DJI controller raised, sacred tourist awe, photoreal, filament only as tiny thread on a phone glass reflection, no logos.
shots.video_prompt: Parking-lot golden hour, faces tilt up in sync as a drone lifts. Beauty as ritual. Horror soft.

shots.narration: In sleep they crop up like aspens under the lids. Wake to webs. Daylight: the Colorado stand was the dream all along.
shots.on_screen: Trees in the blood. Webs in the dark.
shots.support: Hallucination cashes the itch. The mountain rhymes.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 dense Colorado aspen clone stand dissolving at edges into dream logic: faint spider-web filaments between trunks, suggestion of sapling tips like under eyelids, gold canopy cathedral, sublime botanical body horror, photoreal, no text.
shots.video_prompt: Clonal aspen cathedral; cut suggestion of webs and sleep-saplings; canopy breathes once. Itch under the wind.

shots.narration: The appearance of mischief is evidence enough with power.
shots.on_screen: Keep the GOLD card — or delete and descend alone.
shots.support: Evidence is a weapon. Consensus is a countdown.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 final key art: lone figure or synchronized trio on Colorado alpine ridge above gold aspens at dusk, filament glints, tragic sublime, film grain, no logos no text.
shots.video_prompt: Unison exhale on ridge, or lonely descent. Hold. Fade. New horror ending energy.
